knowledge.name: Fixed synthetic patient-access records
knowledge.detail: Fixed fictional patients, forms, coverage evidence, visits, providers, dates, and candidate slots enable deterministic demos.

knowledge.name: Patient-intake review and privacy rules
knowledge.detail: Rules require minimum-necessary synthetic data, separate source evidence from decisions, and prohibit live data and autonomous action.

knowledge.name: Operation skills and locked evidence anchors
knowledge.detail: Four skills define routing, evidence contracts, unknown-ID stops, safety notices, and staff-review gates.

intelligence_processing.name: Intake readiness assessment
intelligence_processing.detail: Summarizes forms, language, and missing items for authorized staff review without changing patient records.

intelligence_processing.name: Coverage evidence transcription
intelligence_processing.detail: Transcribes payer evidence and follow-up without deciding eligibility, network status, referrals, benefits, or patient cost.

intelligence_processing.name: Candidate appointment availability review
intelligence_processing.detail: Shows candidate provider slots for staff review; nothing is held, reserved, booked, rescheduled, or canceled.

intelligence_processing.name: Pre-visit readiness synthesis
intelligence_processing.detail: Combines visit context, missing items, coverage follow-up, and the required reviewer in a minimum-necessary draft.

intelligence_processing.name: Deterministic routing and fail-closed selection
intelligence_processing.detail: Routes four read-only operations and rejects unknown patients or providers without substitution or invented evidence.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio conversational workspace
clients_user_interface.detail: Offers a Draft Copilot Studio agent with four skills, two synthetic knowledge files, no web search, and no action tools.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs PatientIntakeAgent in local Brainstem chat with deterministic, synthetic-only routing.

clients_user_interface.name: Role-based staff review experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Provides staff compact, evidence-first drafts with explicit privacy, source-system, and human-review boundaries.

management_reporting.name: Intake completeness review
management_reporting.detail: Reports forms, preferred language, and outstanding synthetic intake items for staff confirmation.

management_reporting.name: Coverage evidence review
management_reporting.detail: Reports payer evidence and follow-up while reserving verification and eligibility decisions for authorized staff.

management_reporting.name: Candidate availability report
management_reporting.detail: Lists provider, date, time, and service candidates while stating no slot was reserved or booked.

management_reporting.name: Pre-visit readiness handoff
management_reporting.detail: Summarizes visit context, unresolved intake and coverage items, and the authorized reviewer required before action.

tools.name: Portable PatientIntakeAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python agent provides four synthetic, read-only operations with no external calls or mutations.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Discovers the portable agent and exposes local chat, streaming, health, and agent endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the validated Draft package with two knowledge files and four skills; the unmanaged export remains unpublished.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 patient-access workflow
tools.detail: Future governed intake seam; it is disconnected from this synthetic package and has no write permission.

tools.name: SharePoint governed intake documents
tools.detail: Future controlled-document seam; the current package uses only bundled fictional knowledge.

tools.name: Approved payer and referral source systems
tools.detail: Future least-privilege verification seam; the agent never verifies coverage, referrals, or eligibility.

tools.name: Approved scheduling system
tools.detail: Future approval-gated scheduling seam; the agent shows candidate slots but never holds or books them.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams staff approvals
tools.detail: Future human-approval seam; no messages, approval requests, scheduling, or record changes are configured.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic and minimum-necessary evidence policy
supporting_features.detail: Uses two fictional patient records and candidate slots; forbids live data, browsing, enrichment, substitution, or invention.

supporting_features.name: Four deterministic read-only operations
supporting_features.detail: Routes intake, coverage, availability, and pre-visit requests to four bounded read-only handlers.

supporting_features.name: Privacy and clinical safety boundary
supporting_features.detail: Protects live patient data and excludes diagnosis, treatment, medical necessity, authorization, and financial decisions.

supporting_features.name: Fail-closed identifier handling
supporting_features.detail: Rejects unknown synthetic IDs and routes live-data or consequential requests to authorized staff without substitution.

supporting_features.name: Authorized staff review gate
supporting_features.detail: Requires authorized patient-access or qualified reviewers to verify source systems and review every substantive output.

supporting_features.name: No scheduling or record mutation without approval
supporting_features.detail: The agent never schedules or mutates records; any downstream action requires separate authorized human approval.

supporting_features.name: Locked validation and publication control
supporting_features.detail: Four cases passed manual and preview validation; no web search or actions are enabled, and publication needs admin approval.
